description: pkix-path/src/lib.rs: the ECDSA P256 OID '1.2.840.10045.4.3.2' appears twice — once as a local const inside EcdsaP256Verifier::verify_signature (line ~730) and again as OID_ECDSA_P256_SHA256 at module level for DefaultVerifier. Same for the RSA OID. Duplicate OID literals are a maintenance hazard: an update or typo fix in one place won't propagate to the other. Reuse: have EcdsaP256Verifier::verify_signature reference OID_ECDSA_P256_SHA256 (or a crate-level const), and likewise for RSA.
title: OID constants duplicated between EcdsaP256Verifier and DefaultVerifier
